 Medium
 Large
 Print This November, Bengaluru will host PLAYINTERPLAY, an eight-day theatre festival at Sabha featuring performances, workshops, readings, and conversations. The festival is part of Inlaks Foundation’s 50th anniversary, bringing together theatre practitioners, artistes and more from across the country. Alongside performances, it will also have workshops and discussions on theatre practice, physical theatre, and sustainability of arts institutions. “We wanted to represent different generations of theatre artistes to bring their work and experiences together, including in the workshops and conversations. For instance, a recent awardee and an older scholar, Abhishek Majumdar, will come together for a session on science fiction writing for the stage, sharing their scripts and discussing the form.  Through these different strands, the festival brings together performances, workshops, conversations and experience-sharing, while highlighting the interplay between thought, learning and practice,” shares Anmol Vellani, the artistic director of the festival.
